title: Dispatch to logical model, then business rules
description: Restates QR Code Generation, 11. Verifying: the same steps upwards. QR Code Generation, 11. Verifying: the same steps upwards: “Read the hcert claim, dispatch on the subclaim to the right logical model, and only then apply business rules.”.

statements.label: Dispatch to logical model, then business rules
statements.requirement: After verification the verifier SHALL decode the hcert entry with the codec registered for its subclaim, falling back to RawPayload. It SHALL then run any registered BusinessRuleHooks and attach their outcomes to the result.
